set.body: Slice G3: ReportRef in eyes4s-results plus the ResultRef chain summary > participant > query contrast > pair > map > fixation > record; typed NavigationError steps with parent functions; a usedBy reverse index (Studio S6.5); lazy per-page entries with eager validity checks and offset pages; ScanpathPosition (0-based) vs FixationNumber (1-based display).
